page0.text:
...go straight home.
Saber's looking forward to lunch, and I am really not in any position to make a detour. I don't have the time.
page0.sourceUnit: セイバールート七日目-19:page0:1

page1.text:
So I make the shrimp balls, one of my specialties.
It's not really a proper meal. If anything, it's more like a snack to have with alcohol or something. I learned to make it while working at an izakaya bar.
page1.sourceUnit: セイバールート七日目-19:page1:1

page2.text:
"Shirou. This is very hot."
Saber tries to put the fried ball—which is between the size of a golf ball and a tennis ball—into her mouth.
page2.sourceUnit: セイバールート七日目-19:page2:1

page3.text: "Hm? Saber, do you not like hot foods, or do you not like food that looks so crude?"
page3.sourceUnit: セイバールート七日目-19:page3:1

page4.text: "No, neither is an issue. The dish being served so hot is interesting, and while the flavoring seems simple, I can still tell care and effort went into its making."
page4.sourceUnit: セイバールート七日目-19:page4:1

page5.text:
"Yeah? Well I'm glad you like it."
"Yes. It is a shame that we cannot share this with Rin and Taiga."
page5.sourceUnit: セイバールート七日目-19:page5:1

page6.text:
Saber continues eating in silence.
She's eating more than usual, so I figure she worked up an appetite training this morning.
page6.sourceUnit: セイバールート七日目-19:page6:1

page7.text:
...
This may not be very manly, but I really like having people eat food I prepare. All the more so when they say it's delicious.
I'm a poor excuse for a Master, so if I can do something like this to make Saber happy, I should work harder on my cooking... Huh?
page7.sourceUnit: セイバールート七日目-19:page7:1

page8.text: Saber is staring intently at her empty plate.
page8.sourceUnit: セイバールート七日目-19:page8:1

page9.text:
"Saber? If it's not enough, I can make more."
"Eh...? N-no, I have enjoyed plenty. I-I-I am not saying that I did not have enough...!"
page9.sourceUnit: セイバールート七日目-19:page9:1

page10.text:
"Oh really? Then let's have our after-meal tea. I'll go make it real quick, so wait here."
I pick up the empty plates and head to the kitchen.
After I've put the dirty dishes in the sink, I put the kettle on to get the tea started.
page10.sourceUnit: セイバールート七日目-19:page10:1

page11.text:
"Oh hey. How about we try a different tea—"
I stick my head out from the kitchen.
But then I hear something.
page11.sourceUnit: セイバールート七日目-19:page11:1

page12.text:
"...This is becoming a problem. Shirou's cooking is just too delicious.
If he were to stop cooking, I may find my will to fight slipping.
...I am still too soft. I have experienced this many times in the past, but I had no idea starvation tactics could be so terrifying."
page12.sourceUnit: セイバールート七日目-19:page12:1
